Real HTTP smoke:real passed twice (runs 4 and 5) against the fixed image mc-plan-core:mcp-f4-core-001-29939a0 (the exact image the MCP-F4-CORE-001 record declares; the producer anchor commit 06de705 differs from the image source 29939a0 only in apps/admin web files, verified by git diff) + isolated PostgreSQL 17 + local JWKS issuer for the admin phase (honestly attributed, not Keycloak) + isolated real Keycloak 26.8.0 for the deactivation regression: the 16 established operations and the real PKCE deactivation chain regress unchanged; the new admin phase exercises all six operations with field-closed payload assertions, cursor pagination walked to a null cursor, [SYNTHETIC-DB-SEED] labeled ADMIN role promotion plus a chain-consistent grant ledger fixture row (everything else observed is real producer data: materialized entitlement granted 3/consumed 1, real audit trail with user_id filter convergence, real outbox rows with PUBLISHED filter and delivery positions); labeled negatives: missing admin:read 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE, admin:read without the ADMIN role 403 ROLE_REQUIRED, bare and service tokens both rejected at the authentication layer with 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED (the admin face declares userOAuth credentials only), raw limit=101 and forged cursor 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, pat:manage-holding administrator requesting an admin:read PAT rejected 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (UNKNOWN_SCOPE catalog exclusion). Zero Bearer/secret occurrences in smoke logs; zero leftover containers, volumes or networks.

Harness findings fixed during smoke authoring (test-only, no SDK behavior change): the service-token admin probe must be a raw HTTP request because the SDK client-side boundary rejects a service-token-only client before sending anything (the producer then rejects the service credential at the authentication layer with 401, not 403, matching the locked userOAuth-only credential face); the PAT catalog exclusion probe needs a caller holding pat:manage with a DEVELOPMENT role (ADMIN qualifies per DEVELOPMENT_ROLES) so the request reaches the locked PUBLIC_SCOPE_CATALOG check.

Closure: final_commit is the docs commit 1409762 on contracts main (= origin/main b90a3b0..1409762 pushed); Finish validated with the repository clean; admin write operations, moderation queue, dual review and appeals remain owner-gated under Q-010; the SDK stays private, local-pack only, and no real consumer integration is claimed.
